title: PAN-OS User-ID Authentication Portal Root RCE

steps.title: Send crafted traffic to exposed portal
steps.text: Attacker sends crafted requests to an internet-exposed User-ID Authentication Portal.
steps.description: Attacker sends crafted requests to an internet-exposed User-ID Authentication Portal.

steps.title: Unauthenticated root RCE
steps.text: Buffer overflow (CVE-2026-0300) yields unauthenticated code execution as root on the firewall.
steps.description: Buffer overflow (CVE-2026-0300) yields unauthenticated code execution as root on the firewall.

steps.title: Deploy EarthWorm and ReverseSocks5
steps.text: Attacker transfers and runs EarthWorm and ReverseSocks5 tunneling tools on the appliance.
steps.description: Attacker transfers and runs EarthWorm and ReverseSocks5 tunneling tools on the appliance.

steps.title: Active Directory enumeration
steps.text: From the firewall, the attacker enumerates Active Directory and internal systems.
steps.description: From the firewall, the attacker enumerates Active Directory and internal systems.

steps.title: Lateral movement and log cleanup
steps.text: Attacker pivots to internal systems and removes logs to hinder investigation.
steps.description: Attacker pivots to internal systems and removes logs to hinder investigation.

steps.title: Detect appliance-originated tunnels
steps.text: Blue team flags the firewall initiating sustained encrypted/SOCKS connections to previously unseen destinations.
steps.description: Blue team flags the firewall initiating sustained encrypted/SOCKS connections to previously unseen destinations.

steps.title: Isolate and remediate firewall
steps.text: SOC isolates the firewall, preserves evidence, removes tooling, upgrades PAN-OS and rotates exposed credentials.
